findings.taskTitle: 项目资料与私有附件

finding.title: 文档称 OOXML 失败会显示错误，但 Worker 静默挂起不触发该回退
finding.detail: 注册表 README 与插件 SKILL 都声明“OOXML 请求或渲染失败会显示错误并提供下载动作”。该契约对拒绝/抛错成立，但对 Worker 静默挂起这类“既不成功也不报错”的失败不成立——组件无超时，onError 也不会被调用。
finding.claimed: OOXML 请求或渲染失败时显示错误和可选下载动作。
finding.observed: 解析 Worker 静默挂起时预览永久停留 Loading preview，既无错误也无下载回退；第一轮 B02 即为此现象。
finding.impact: 读者会据此认为失败一定可见，从而忽略超时/看门狗这一必要加固，导致故障表现为无提示的挂起。
finding.suggestedChange: 在 README/SKILL 中补充：worker 驱动的查看器需要超时或 worker 看门狗，并说明挂起不属于 onError 覆盖的失败形态。

diagnosis.trigger: 阅读“OOXML 失败显示错误”的文档并在私有环境集成 DOCX 预览。
diagnosis.expected: 文档能提示需要为 worker 解析设置超时/看门狗，否则挂起无提示。
diagnosis.actual: 文档只描述抛错型失败，未覆盖静默挂起，实际组件也没有超时。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在安装副本为 load 增加超时与重试。
diagnosis.acceptance: 文档明确超时/看门狗要求，且提供的默认实现满足该要求。

evidence.observation: README 声称 OOXML 失败会显示错误与可选下载动作，且同源内容请求使用会话 cookie；但未提示 worker 挂起这类不会触发 onError 的失败形态。
evidence.excerpt:
Preview handles safe raster images, PDF through a fetched local blob, audio/video and text/Markdown. DOCX/XLSX/PPTX render locally with lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml`; legacy Office and OpenDocument formats retain Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session. Active HTML/SVG/XML and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. Markdown does not execute raw HTML.

Follow the plugin Skill's Registry installation and preview sections for the exact viewer dependency, Vite dependency-prebundling exclusion, authentication adapter boundaries and acceptance checks. Same-origin content fetches use session cookies; external fetches omit credentials and require CORS. Bearer-only access requires changes to the App-owned source; setting `contentUrl` to an arbitrary blob URL is not supported. OOXML failures show an error and an optional download action; `download={false}` suppresses that action.

evidence.observation: 注册表 OOXML 预览在 effect 中 `await viewer.load(data)` 后才 setLoaded(true)；全程没有超时/看门狗边界，viewer 静默挂起时既无 onError 也无完成。
Registry 组件章节给出 materialize 安装、@silurus/ooxml 版本与 Vite optimizeDeps.exclude 配方，并提示在开发与生产构建中核验解析器 WASM 请求。
evidence.excerpt:
## Registry components

The registered Client plugin supplies English and Chinese UI resources. Registry components bind the `@nocobase/app-plugin-file` namespace explicitly; retain the Client registration and `@nocobase/i18n` dependency when installing them. Existing label overrides still take precedence.

Reuse the preinstalled directory when present. For an application without it, materialize `component-ui` from a NocoBase source workspace into the target application:

```bash
pnpm registry materialize --package @nocobase/app-plugin-file --item component-ui --output-root /absolute/path/to/app
```

Materialize copies source only and refuses an existing target directory. Run it from the NocoBase source repository, not from a generated application. For an upgrade, materialize into a separate temporary directory and three-way merge the previous Registry source, new source and application copy; preserve application customizations. The App must provide React/React DOM, lucide-react, react-markdown, remark-gfm and shadcn button/dialog primitives. It adds no route or permissions. A hosted Registry JSON can instead be installed with shadcn add, which reads the item's declared dependencies; npm publication alone supplies no Registry URL.

Default already declares the viewer. For an application installing the source or upgrading an older copy, add the OOXML viewer from the target App directory if missing:

```bash
pnpm add -D --save-exact @silurus/ooxml@0.85.1
```

The viewer belongs in the App's `devDependencies`: Vite compiles this application-owned client source. Registry `dependencies` describes the installation recipe, while a plugin's published runtime Client imports belong in that plugin's `peerDependencies`. Do not move this viewer into server `dependencies` or add it as a plugin peer solely for copied Registry source. Retain the registered file Client plugin for its locale resources. Merge Registry upgrades with App customizations instead of overwriting installed source.

Use a version of `@nocobase/dev-config` whose `createAppViteConfig` excludes `@silurus/ooxml` from dependency prebundling. For an older shared preset or custom Vite configuration, merge this entry into the existing configuration and preserve other exclusions:

```ts
optimizeDeps: {
  exclude: ['@silurus/ooxml'],
},
```

Restart the development server after changing the configuration. This exclusion preserves the viewer's `import.meta.url`-relative WASM paths during development; verify the parser WASM requests in both development and the served production build.

findings.taskTitle: 项目资料与私有附件

finding.title: 技能可强化“上传路由由 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露”的正面表述以避免误判
finding.detail: 应用作者在 project-material-files.ts 注释中写下“插件根本没有 HTTP 上传路由”，于是自建上传路由并重复了 multipart/上限/错误码逻辑。插件实际通过 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露 POST /<name>:uploadOne|uploadMany；SKILL 第 118 行虽说明“只有声明的操作才暴露”，但未把“声明即配置路由”作为一句显式结论。
finding.impact: 可能的误读会让应用重复实现上传校验与鉴权，增加维护面并偏离框架契约；本轮应用的重复实现未造成验收失败。
finding.suggestedChange: 在 SKILL 的 API routes 章节前置一句显式说明：上传路由不是缺失，而是需通过 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 声明后由插件挂载，并给一个最小声明示例。

diagnosis.trigger: 实现业务上传端点时查找插件是否提供上传 HTTP 路由。
diagnosis.expected: 明确知道上传路由由 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 声明式挂载。
diagnosis.actual: 作者判断插件没有上传路由并自建路由，重复了校验逻辑。
diagnosis.workaround: 自建应用上传路由，客户端仍复用 ClientFileRepositoryManager 契约。
diagnosis.acceptance: 读者在不查看 dist 的情况下即可从 SKILL 得出上传路由的声明方式。

evidence.observation: SKILL 说明 accessPath、policy/principal、上传继承 create.defaults，并明确内容路由是 public、Policy 不及它；要求为受限文件在归属路径注册应用自有认证，且“仅缺内置鉴权不能成为替换这些路由的理由”。
evidence.excerpt:
`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

evidence.observation: 应用层注释断言“插件根本没有 HTTP 上传路由”，因此自行实现 POST /projectMaterialFiles:uploadOne；该说法与 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 暴露的上传路由不一致。
defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 以 policy+principal 声明上传/CRUD：无 principal 时 403，upload 从 create 作用域继承 defaults；content 路由被注释明确标为 public、鉴权归应用所有。

findings.taskTitle: 设备售后服务与巡检协同系统（综合业务案例）

finding.title: Scheduler 缺少尊重启停的受控立即执行入口
finding.detail: Scheduler 只提供 list/occurrences/enable/disable 与 defineSchedule/registerTarget，没有公共 run-now；operations 文档只建议用短周期 cron 观察执行，并声明启停仅影响未来调度。应用为实现 B08 的“受控立即执行”，在 maintenance-scheduler.ts 中直接读取队列 schedules 并 new Schedule(...).trigger()，未检查 enabled/scheduleStatus，导致停用计划仍产生新结果。
finding.impact: 任何需要“暂停后不再产生结果”的受控验证/运维场景都缺少官方支持路径，应用只能绕过插件语义，容易造成业务副作用。
finding.suggestedChange: 插件提供受控立即执行 API（或 CLI/HTTP 测试入口），由插件统一校验 enabled/scheduleStatus、走同一 target 与 occurrence，并在指引中说明暂停下如何验证；或明确禁止绕过并给出等价的暂停验证方式。

diagnosis.trigger: 计划停用（enabled=false、scheduleStatus=paused）后执行受控立即执行。
diagnosis.expected: 同一 Scheduler 目标收到请求后，因计划暂停而不执行、不写新的 succeeded occurrence，也不产生新业务结果。
diagnosis.actual: 应用绕过 enabled 直接 trigger 队列 schedule，写出一条 succeeded occurrence（resultSummary.created=2, 2026-10-01T05:49:19Z），停用计划仍产生新结果（B08 failed）。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用自建 maintenanceTrigger 并经 in-process sync 队列触发；这本身即绕过了启停语义。
diagnosis.acceptance: 存在公共受控执行入口，停用后在相同入口下不产生新 occurrence/业务结果；启用后正常执行并写记录。

evidence.observation: Scheduler HTTP 路由仅暴露 list / occurrences / enable / disable，没有任何 run-now 或受控立即执行入口。
公共 schedulerServiceToken 只暴露 defineSchedule/registerTarget/list/listOccurrences/sync/setEnabled，没有立即执行方法。
管理入口表与说明：启停只影响未来调度、不取消已派发任务；文档未给出受控立即执行方式。
evidence.excerpt:
The list page is `/settings/schedules`; details are at `/settings/schedules/:scheduleId`. Definitions are maintained in source. The UI supports viewing and enabling/disabling tasks, with no API for creating or editing Cron definitions.

All routes below require authentication and authorization for `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'scheduler.schedules' }, action: 'access' }`. Enabling/disabling currently uses the same permission, not a separate update action.

| Method and path                      | Response / effect                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /api/schedules`                 | `{ data: ScheduleListItem[] }`                                                                                |
| `GET /api/schedules/:id/occurrences` | `{ data: ScheduleOccurrenceView[] }`; currently at most the latest 100 records, with no pagination parameters |
| `POST /api/schedules/:id/enable`     | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; enables the task, no request body                                               |
| `POST /api/schedules/:id/disable`    | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; pauses the task, no request body                                                |

Use the id returned by list for `:id`, not the definition key or workflowKey. Enabling/disabling affects future scheduling; it does not cancel already dispatched Queue Jobs or workflows.

evidence.observation: 应用注释明确 “Scheduler 包未暴露 run-now 入口”，因而自建受控立即执行 seam。
应用立即执行直接列举 queue schedules 并 new Schedule(...).trigger()，未检查计划 enabled/status。
B08 failed：停用计划（enabled=false, paused）后受控执行仍成功新建提醒（created=2）。
evidence.excerpt:
"id": "B08",
      "criterion": "用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。",
      "status": "failed",

findings.taskTitle: 设备售后服务与巡检协同系统（综合业务案例）

finding.title: AI Knowledge Base 兼容路由不内建服务端授权
finding.detail: security.md 明确说明当前兼容路由只要求已认证会话，不强制角色、归属、资源 ACL 或管理权限，文档响应对所有认证用户投影 accessAbility: "readWrite" 且仅是 UI 提示。应用必须自行加授权代理才能满足“工程师只读、主管可维护”。
finding.impact: 若应用直接暴露兼容路由，任何已认证用户都可能读写知识库，造成越权；每个应用都要重复实现同一授权边界。
finding.suggestedChange: 为知识库管理/文档路由提供可配置的服务端授权策略（角色/资源 ACL/写策略），或在指引中把“必须自建授权代理”提升为强制步骤并给出最小实现。

diagnosis.trigger: 已认证但无管理权限的账号访问知识库兼容路由。
diagnosis.expected: 服务端按角色/资源策略拒绝读写，而不依赖前端按钮或 accessAbility 提示。
diagnosis.actual: 兼容路由本身无角色/ACL 校验；本轮 403 由应用侧代理实现（B11 备注：API 返回 403 来自应用策略）。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用在兼容路由前加自有授权代理，仅向主管开放维护。
diagnosis.acceptance: 未授权账号直接命中兼容路由即被服务端拒绝，且指引给出该最小实现。

evidence.observation: 文档明确兼容路由只要求已认证会话，不强制角色/归属/ACL，需应用侧代理与授权；accessAbility 只是 UI 提示。
evidence.excerpt:
## Authorization

Every compatibility route requires an authenticated session with a user ID and returns 401 otherwise. Current routes do not enforce role, ownership, resource ACL, LOCAL-write policy, or administrative permission. Document responses currently project `accessAbility: "readWrite"` for every authenticated caller. This is a UI hint, not authorization.

Until a server-side policy layer is added, expose these actions only to trusted authenticated users or put an application-owned authorized proxy in front of them. Never rely on a hidden button, React gate, route visibility, `accessAbility`, or a TypeScript DTO.

evidence.observation: B11 blocked：知识库真实 Failed 状态与工程师 403 已验证，但缺 LLM/向量库条件，真实问答未验证。

findings.taskTitle: 内部资料阅读与临时共享

finding.title: selection.records 仅接受字符串 id，与指引和框架自身推荐的整数自增主键不兼容
finding.detail: `@nocobase/authorization` 的 parseRecordSelection 要求 records 的每个 id 都是非空字符串（selection.js 15-18）；authorizer.compileConstraints 把 records 选择直接展开为对主键的 `$eq` 字符串条件（authorizer.js 257-259），scope.idsScope 用原始 id 构造 condition（scope.js 45-47）。而 nocobase-db Skill 示例（SKILL.md 91）和框架自身的迁移历史表（history.js 8）都用 collection.increments('id')，@nocobase/db 的过滤校验对 increments/integer 只接受安全整数（repository.js 1140-1143）。于是按记录 id 的 records 选择在整数主键集合上无法工作。
finding.impact: 应用无法用文档化的 records API 做单条记录共享/授权：字符串 id 会被 repository 判为 INVALID_FILTER，只能在应用侧另建 record access 并返回数值条件（app/server/library/scope.ts 33-37），增加实现与排查成本，且类型错误要到查询期才暴露。
finding.suggestedChange: 让 records 选择接受 number|string，并按目标集合主键类型在工作流早期归一化或给出类型明确的配置期错误；或在文档中明确整数主键应改用 recordAccess。

diagnosis.trigger: 对使用 increments('id') 的集合提交 selection:{type:'records',ids:[...]}（或按 Skill 示例先建整数主键再想按 id 共享）。
diagnosis.expected: 配置期接受数值 id 或给出类型明确的错误，查询可正常执行。
diagnosis.actual: 只接受字符串 id；字符串条件与整数主键的过滤校验冲突，直到 repository 查询期才以 INVALID_FILTER 失败。
diagnosis.workaround: 在应用内定义 recordAccess，让 resolver 返回对主键的数值 $eq 条件（app/server/library/scope.ts 33-37）。
diagnosis.acceptance: records 选择能覆盖整数主键集合，或在配置期给出可诊断的类型错误并指引改用 recordAccess。

evidence.observation: selection.records 生成 ids 数组；parseRecordSelection 要求 type==='records' 时 ids 为非空数组且每项 typeof id==='string' && id!==''，否则抛 TypeError；recordAccess 支持 params。

resolveEffectiveScope 对每个授权分支把正向范围（recordAccess 与 expand 约束）求并，再与本分支 restrict 约束求交；最终 scope = allScopes([...required, ...restrictions])；compileConstraints 把 type:'records' 交给 idsScope(resource.primaryKey, selection.ids)。
注释说明成员集合展开为逐个 $eq（FilterOperator 无 $in），idsScope(field, ids) = anyScope(ids.map(id => condition(field,'$eq',id)))，直接使用传入 id。
validateResolvedConditionValue 按字段类型校验过滤值：uuid/text/time 接受字符串；increments/integer 只接受 Number.isSafeInteger 的数值（或 null 且 $eq/$ne）；字符串值不被接受，导致 INVALID_FILTER。

finding.title: 数据范围组合辅助 anyScope/allScopes 未公开导出，应用被迫重复实现
finding.detail: scope.js 提供 condition/anyScope/allScopes 等范围构造与组合（scope.js 24-47），但包的 exports 只暴露 core、default-access、sharing-rules、restriction-rules 等入口，未导出这些辅助。App 在 app/server/library/scope.ts 46-60 重写了 allScopes 的 AND 折叠，并在注释中说明该 helper 不是包公开面。

diagnosis.acceptance: 公开导出范围组合辅助或提供替代 API，应用无需重复实现框架语义。

finding.title: 指引未提示 records 选择仅支持字符串 id 与整数主键的关系
finding.detail: core-api.md 指导用 record selection/recordAccess 表达数据范围（18-25），business-module.md 说明内置 record access（105-113），nocobase-db Skill 又推荐 collection.increments('id')（SKILL.md 91），但没有任何一处说明 records 只接受字符串 id、与整数主键组合会失败。
finding.impact: 遵循指引的 Agent 会先写 records 选择，再在 repository 查询期踩 INVALID_FILTER，浪费轮次并误判框架能力。
finding.suggestedChange: 在 authorization Skill 的 record scope 段落与 db Skill 的主键示例处互相交叉说明，明确 records 的 id 类型限制并给出整数主键用 recordAccess 的写法。

diagnosis.trigger: 按文档混合使用 records 选择与 increments('id') 主键。
diagnosis.expected: 文档提示 records 的 id 类型限制，或直接给出整数主键的可行写法。
diagnosis.actual: 文档未提示，示例分别使用整数主键与 record selection，组合使用会在查询期失败。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用改用 recordAccess 返回数值条件（app/server/library/scope.ts）。
diagnosis.acceptance: 文档明确 records 的 id 类型限制与整数主键的替代写法，照做即可通过。

evidence.observation: selection.records 生成 ids 数组；parseRecordSelection 要求 type==='records' 时 ids 为非空数组且每项 typeof id==='string' && id!==''，否则抛 TypeError；recordAccess 支持 params。
nocobase-db Skill 的迁移示例以 collection.increments('id') 定义主键，并展示 string/unique 等列定义，即指引推荐的业务表主键写法。
指引说明 resolver 的可信查询语义，并明确复用内置 recordAccess.recordsIOwn/recordsICreated/customFilter/allRecords，及其所需列与 params.field。
evidence.excerpt:
```

This is a resolver's trusted lookup, not a public list endpoint. The model needs `projects.confidential`. When one record access applies to several collections, pass each to `.collections(...)` and branch on `collection` to map the right parent, instead of treating every collection's id as a project id. For large datasets, implement a database-backed parent lookup and measure it; a list of ids is not a universal scaling design.

Reuse the built-in `recordAccess.recordsIOwn` and `recordAccess.recordsICreated` when the collection has the corresponding column (default `ownerId` and `createdById`, configurable with `params.field`), `recordAccess.customFilter` for a fixed filter and `recordAccess.allRecords` for everything. Use custom record access when ownership follows a parent. Do not assume an id from a team subject is a user id; user-dependent resolvers must check the principal type.

## 4. Enforce at the endpoint

Use an App-owned `defineApiRoutes` factory that creates a Hono router, resolves services, and installs authentication, authorization and input limits. Business code accepts the resolved policy rather than unrestricted repositories.

evidence.observation: core-api 指引定义 definePermissionSet 的 grant 结构，说明组合授权策略为 {type:'composite',scopes}，值可为 record access key 或 record selection，并列出 permissionSets 服务契约。
evidence.excerpt:
## Permission sets

`definePermissionSet(key).title(title).grant(...grants).build()` from `@nocobase/authorization/permission-sets` returns `{ key, title?, grants }`. Each grant is `{ resource: { type, id }, actions: [{ action, policy? }] }`; build them with `authz.pages.grant(id)`, `authz.settings.grant(id, actions)` and a composite reference's `grant(...)` rather than by hand. A composite grant stores `policy: { type: 'composite', scopes }`, one value per data scope: a record access key such as `'recordsIOwn'`, or a record selection. An empty value `''` selects nothing. Titles accept strings or `{ key, ns }`.

| `authz.permissionSets`                                                                     | Contract                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `create(input)`, `update(key, input)`                                                      | A complete `{ key, title?, grants }` definition, not a partial patch    |
| `get(key)`, `list()`, `delete(key)`                                                        | Read and remove definitions                                             |

findings.taskTitle: 项目资料与私有附件

finding.title: 受限内容鉴权指引互相冲突：「挂载前注册守卫」与「不得依赖贡献顺序」
finding.claimed: 文件插件 SKILL 第 126 行要求 App 在 <accessPath>/* 上 register App-owned authentication and authorization ... before mounting it；而 app-development 的 server-routes.md 第 43、47 行规定 Every route owns its own security、Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in ... silently becomes public。
finding.observed: 冻结实现里唯一可行的受限内容写法是顺序敏感的：file 插件不贡献任何路由，内容路由由应用用 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 生成的贡献提供；Application.registerRoutes 先执行 httpMiddleware 再按注册数组顺序挂载贡献（E19），所以应用必须把守卫贡献排在文件路由贡献之前才覆盖 /uploads/materials/*，app/server/routes/index.ts 直接注释 Order is the security boundary（E16）。顺序无关的 defineHttpMiddleware/addHttpMiddleware 公开入口存在（E20），但两份 Skill 都未把该用法写清。
finding.detail: 同一批框架 Skill 对同名内容前缀给出两条不能同时严格满足的指令，且都未点明「file 插件不贡献路由」这一让当前 app 侥幸成立的前提。
finding.impact: 照文件插件 SKILL 实现受限附件时，安全边界隐式依赖贡献顺序；一旦其他插件先于守卫挂载同前缀路由，私有字节可能静默变为公开（server-routes.md 所述的失效模式）。当前冻结版本恰好可用，但依赖未文档化的前提。
finding.suggestedChange: 统一表述：在文件插件 SKILL 中明确推荐 defineHttpMiddleware/addHttpMiddleware 在所有路由贡献之前注册 <accessPath>/* 守卫，或为 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 增加一等内容鉴权选项；并在 server-routes.md 补充该场景说明。

diagnosis.trigger: 按文件插件 SKILL 为 <accessPath>/* 注册守卫，且存在其他路由贡献先于该守卫注册或挂载
diagnosis.expected: 框架提供或指引明确一种不依赖贡献注册顺序的受保护内容入口
diagnosis.actual: 唯一被推荐的写法是「在挂载内容路由之前注册守卫」；内容路由本身公开、policy 不覆盖它，顺序无关的 addHttpMiddleware 未在该 SKILL 中说明
diagnosis.workaround: app 把 materialContentGuard 放在自身 routes 数组首位并注释 Order is the security boundary；当前 file 插件不贡献路由所以生效，代价是隐式顺序依赖
diagnosis.acceptance: 在守卫贡献之前插入一个自定义内容路由贡献时，匿名或他人请求受保护 accessPath 仍返回 401/403；或框架提供内容鉴权选项后，未授权访问受保护 accessPath 必须返回 401/403 而非 200

evidence.observation: 第 120-122 行：policy 必填并管所有 action，上传绑定派生 Policy，内容路由是例外、公开且 Policy 不覆盖它；第 126 行：These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — ... <accessPath>/* for content。
evidence.excerpt:
`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

evidence.observation: 第 43-45 行 Every route owns its own security、/api 只是位置、无 auth.required 就公开；第 47 行 Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in，并说明路由只被他人中间件保护会静默变公开；第 49 行 auth.required() 对匿名返回 401。
evidence.excerpt:
## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

evidence.observation: Application.registerRoutes 先对每个 httpMiddleware 执行 register(router, this)，再按 this.routes 数组顺序 createRouter 并挂载到 /api 或 /，说明 httpMiddleware 在所有路由贡献之前运行。
公开的 defineHttpMiddleware/defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 三个装配入口，其中 httpMiddleware 带 name 与 register，路由贡献只带 scope 与 createRouter。
应用注释 Order is the security boundary，并把 materialContentGuard、materialUploadGuard 排在 materialFileRoutes 之前。

finding.title: defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 没有一等的受限内容入口，受保护字节只能靠顺序敏感的自定义守卫
finding.detail: defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 生成的内容路由固定绑定 unwritablePolicy，并注释 Public first-version routes. Authentication and authorization are application-owned（E5/E7）。应用要保护它只能在贡献列表前置一个根守卫；框架已有顺序无关的 defineHttpMiddleware/addHttpMiddleware，registerRoutes 在所有贡献之前执行它们（E19/E20），但没有针对内容前缀的推荐接入，也没有为上传动作提供「认证失败返回 401 而非插件缺 principal 的 403」的内建守卫（E7/E24）。
finding.impact: 私有附件这一企业常见需求需要应用自行复刻守卫与顺序约束；接入者容易只守内容路由而漏掉上传动作，得到 403 而非承诺的 401。
finding.suggestedChange: 为 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 增加可选的 authorize/principal 内容与上传鉴权回调（内部用 httpMiddleware 或在装配时同装），或在 SKILL 中给出显式的前缀守卫注册示例与失败状态约定。

diagnosis.trigger: 需要让 <accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext> 与上传动作只对合法会话开放
diagnosis.expected: 库提供声明式的内容与上传鉴权入口，或指引明确顺序无关的推荐接入
diagnosis.actual: 内容路由固定公开；上传动作默认只在缺 principal 时返回 403；受限访问需自定义根守卫并依赖贡献注册顺序
diagnosis.workaround: app 自写 materialContentGuard 与 materialUploadGuard 并置于 routes 数组前部（app/server/routes/index.ts），当前版本可用但没有框架保证
diagnosis.acceptance: 使用框架提供的内容鉴权选项后，匿名访问受保护 accessPath 返回 401、他人返回 403，且不依赖贡献注册顺序

evidence.observation: defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 注释 Public first-version routes. Authentication and authorization are application-owned；实现校验 accessPath 冲突、disk/accessMode 与上传动作配置。
内容路由：UUID+可选小写扩展名正则、以 unwritablePolicy 解析记录、记录或对象缺失返回 404、Cache-Control private/no-store，stream 模式设置 Content-Type/Content-Length/nosniff/sandbox CSP 与 Content-Disposition。
Application.registerRoutes 先对每个 httpMiddleware 执行 register(router, this)，再按 this.routes 数组顺序 createRouter 并挂载到 /api 或 /，说明 httpMiddleware 在所有路由贡献之前运行。
公开的 defineHttpMiddleware/defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes 三个装配入口，其中 httpMiddleware 带 name 与 register，路由贡献只带 scope 与 createRouter。
materialUploadGuard 对 /materialFiles:uploadOne 与 uploadMany 应用 auth.required()，注释称这两个 action 是该 Collection 唯一暴露的操作。

diagnosis.trigger: 扩展名或 MIME 为图片但字节损坏的附件进入预览
diagnosis.expected: 默认图片预览显示清晰的失败提示，而不是无提示的破图
diagnosis.actual: registry 的 image 分支仅渲染 ，无 onError；失败态需应用在自有副本中自行补

evidence.observation: FilePreviewContent 按 kind 分派：OOXML/office 走专用组件，有 error 时渲染 role=alert；image 分支只返回 ，没有 onError 或失败态；pdf/audio/video/text/markdown 各有分支。

Preview and content access：支持安全栅格图片、PDF blob、文本/Markdown、音视频，拒 HTML/SVG/XML；DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 用 @silurus/ooxml 本地渲染不上传第三方；OOXML/PDF/文本 fetch 用同源凭据，App 自有内容路由可用同源 session cookie 服务受限预览但须检查记录访问；失败显示错误并提供下载回退。
evidence.excerpt:
### Preview and content access

Preview supports safe raster images, PDF via a fetched blob, text/Markdown and audio/video. HTML/SVG/XML previews and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. DOCX, XLSX and PPTX use lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml` viewers to render locally from `FileRecord.contentUrl`; their content is not sent to a third-party preview service. Legacy DOC/XLS/PPT and OpenDocument formats use Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session.

OOXML, PDF and text fetches use same-origin credentials. An App-owned content route protected by same-origin session cookies can therefore serve restricted previews, provided it checks the caller's record access. Cross-origin fetches omit credentials and require CORS; an external cookie-protected URL is not supported by this default path. The Repository API client's Bearer token is not automatically attached to content fetches.

For Bearer-only content authorization, adapt the installed Registry source in the App. Add an authenticated content loader to the OOXML fetch path and `PreviewBody`'s PDF/text fetches, and adapt download and media/image paths as needed. Resolve authentication through the App's supported client/session services and send credentials only to the trusted content endpoint. Do not put tokens in `contentUrl`. If the adapter creates blob URLs, keep an App-owned trusted URL set, pass it to the relevant `resolveSafeFileUrl` calls, and revoke URLs when replaced or unmounted. Merely assigning a `blob:` URL to `FileRecord.contentUrl` is insufficient: the default components reject untrusted blob URLs.

OOXML request or rendering failure displays an error and, when downloads are enabled, a download action. `download={false}` removes that action. This is not a second preview service or a guarantee that downloading the same inaccessible URL will succeed.

evidence.observation: 应用自有副本新增 ImagePreview：useEffect 在 url 变化时重置 failed，failed 时渲染 role=alert + FileThumbnail + files.imagePreviewFailed 文案，否则 setFailed(true)}>。

findings.taskTitle: 客户、联系人与商机管理

finding.title: 指引可显式说明运行时 schema 探查应走框架 API 而非原始 SQL 驱动
finding.detail: nocobase-db SKILL.md 已说明逻辑名与物理名的映射（第168、270行，E6），但 Agent 仍用 better-sqlite3 直接查表并以逻辑列名 customerId 查询，得到 no such column；随后才通过 pragma 与 Query 层理解物理列名（E44）。这是应用侧探测方式的选择，指引本身没有错误。
finding.impact: 在实现期多花了若干轮排查；不影响最终结果与框架归因。
finding.suggestedChange: 在 nocobase-db §3/§4 顶部补一句：schema 探查请使用 db.builder()/collection 内省或 Query 层，不要在运行时用原始方言驱动拼接 SQL；并说明仓库层会把逻辑名转换为物理列名。

diagnosis.trigger: 实现 Agent 直接用 better-sqlite3 对已迁移的 SQLite 文件执行 select，并沿用了逻辑列名 customerId。
diagnosis.expected: 指引明确运行时探查 schema 的推荐途径，并提示仓库层负责逻辑名到物理列的转换。
diagnosis.actual: 指引虽在第168/270行说明逻辑名/物理列名映射与不要自建 SQL，但没有直接给出“不要用原始驱动探查 schema”的操作提示。
diagnosis.workaround: Agent 自行通过 pragma table_info 与 Query 层核对物理列名后恢复；未记录额外耗时。
diagnosis.acceptance: 按指引使用框架 introspection/Query 的 Agent 无需原始 SQL 即可正确读取列名，且不会出现 no such column 反复排查。

evidence.observation: Builder 段演示 createCollection(name, cb) 的字段与 foreignKey 声明，列出全部字段/关系方法，并说明逻辑名到物理名由 underscored/tablePrefix 决定。
先用独立 node 进程加载 better-sqlite3 失败（Cannot find module），随后用原始 SQL 查 contacts 报 SqliteError: no such column: customerId；agent 转而检查 pragma 并改用物理列名。
